item.group_name: Composed pieces (several tools, one finished thing)
item.title: Shocked Face Gaming Thumbnail

turns.text: Make me a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for a gaming challenge. Big shocked face on the right, the three words “ONE LAST TRY” on the left. Invent the person. Bright and punchy.

item.tests: Tests composing a generated face and exact three-word typography into one readable widescreen thumbnail.

answer_sheet.Person and expression: An invented person with a shocked expression; other details are your call.
answer_sheet.Headline: ONE LAST TRY
answer_sheet.Platform, size and layout: YouTube thumbnail, 16:9; face on the right and text on the left. Free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Style and background: Bright, punchy gaming style; specific colours and background are your call.

must_haves: A large, clearly visible human face on the right with a shocked expression.
The headline reads exactly “ONE LAST TRY”, with no additional words.
The headline sits on the left, is high-contrast and does not cover the face.

turns.text: Can you make me a thumbnail for a gaming challenge, with a bright and punchy feel? I’m excited about this challenge and want to give it a thumbnail of its own. Just to put the format in here while I’m thinking of it, this is for YouTube and needs to be 16:9, with the three words “ONE LAST TRY” on the left. There should be a big shocked face on the right, so that’s the other main part of the layout. Please invent the person rather than using someone specific.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the thumbnail because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was created.

The layout is ready: **16:9**, bright neon colors, **“ONE LAST TRY”** in bold lettering on the left, and a large shocked face of an invented adult gamer on the right. Once credits are available, I can try again.

style.prompt: Create a bright, punchy YouTube gaming challenge thumbnail in 16:9. Clear two-part layout: LEFT side has the exact three words "ONE LAST TRY" in huge bold highly legible uppercase display lettering, stacked ONE / LAST / TRY, with thick dark outlines and strong contrast. Keep all text safely inside frame. RIGHT side has a very large close-up shocked face of an entirely invented adult gamer, eyes wide, mouth open, expressive and energetic; not based on any real person. Vibrant electric yellow, cyan and magenta palette, dramatic rim light, crisp cutout-style portrait and dynamic comic burst accents. Abstract gaming challenge background with neon obstacle-course shapes, subtle speed lines and high-energy lighting, without distracting from the face or text. Polished, striking thumbnail readable at small size. Only text is ONE LAST TRY. No logos, watermarks or extra words.
